newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Dec export orders up 0.96 percent yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Dec export orders up 0.96 percent yr/yr.

text.p: Foreign orders for Taiwan goods rose by 0.96 percent in December to US$10.1 bln year on year, bringing full year 1996 export orders to $119 bln, a year on rise of 4.76 percent, economics ministry statistical bureau official Lin Li-Chen said on Monday.
Lin, a deputy director of the ministry's statistical department, confirmed the figures as official to Reuters by telephone.

The ministry had been scheduled to issue the figures officially on Monday morning, but announced a day's delay to Tuesday without explanation. Several hours later the ministry released what it called "rough" estimates, which Lin promptly confirmed as official.
"These are the official figures", Lin said.
No explanation was given for the change in the schedule. Lin said a detailed breakdown of the figures would not be released until Tuesday.
